data.name: Neda
data.gender_notes: Neda is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Neda was a goddess of fertility and consolation. She was also revered as a protector of the young and a healer. The name Neda carries the meaning “Comfort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Neda usually hope their child will grow to embody comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Neda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comfort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neda total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: נדא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם נדא הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'מתנה של אלוהים' או 'נדיבות אלוהים'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'נד' שפירושו מתנה, ו'א' שפירושו אלוהים. השם נדא מופיע בתנ"ך כמתנה מאלוהים לאנושות.

in_greek.name: Νέδα
in_greek.meaning: Δωρεά του Θεού, γενναιοσύνη του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νέδα είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει 'Δωρεά του Θεού' ή 'γενναιοσύνη του Θεού'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος δεν είναι σαφής, αλλά πιθανόν να προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'νέδος' που σημαίνει 'ανάγκη' ή 'ضرورة'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Νέδα συνδέεται με την έννοια της δωρεάς και της γενναιοσύνης του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Neda
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Neda significat 'Donum Dei' vel 'liberalitas Dei'. Etymologia nominis non est clara, sed probabiliter derivatur a voce 'donum' quae significat 'donum' vel 'munus'. In traditione ecclesiastica, nomen Neda coniungitur cum conceptu doni et liberalitatis Dei.

in_english.name: Neda
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, generosity of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Neda means 'Gift of God' or 'generosity of God'. It is derived from Hebrew roots, specifically from the words 'nad' meaning 'gift' and 'El' meaning 'God'. Although it does not appear directly in the Bible, the name Neda is associated with the concept of God's gift to humanity. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing the divine gift of life and spiritual blessings. Personality traits associated with the name Neda include kindness, generosity, and a strong sense of faith.

data.cultural_impact: In Persian culture, "Neda" means "voice" or "call." This name has been traditionally given to girls born between the winter solstice and the vernal equinox. As a result, Neda signifies both the end of one cycle, represented by winter, and the beginning of a new cycle, symbolized by the vernal equinox and the onset of spring.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, Neda evokes images of the hymn "O come, O come, Emmanuel," which uses the name "Nedjed" or "Nadja" to refer to God. In this hymn, God is portrayed as a consoling presence, especially during times of hardship and despair. The spiritual significance of the name Neda is therefore rooted in its original meaning as a goddess of consolation and healing, making it a fitting reminder of the comforting presence of God.
